query:
WITH avg_by_discount AS (
  SELECT is_discounted,
         AVG(DATEDIFF(gdate_paid, gdate_happened)) AS avg_days
  FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation
  WHERE gdate_happened BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND gdate_paid IS NOT NULL
    AND status_description != 'Cancelled due to the violator death'
  GROUP BY is_discounted
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN is_discounted = TRUE THEN avg_days END) AS avg_days_discounted,
  MAX(CASE WHEN is_discounted = FALSE THEN avg_days END) AS avg_days_non_discounted,
  MAX(CASE WHEN is_discounted = FALSE THEN avg_days END) - MAX(CASE WHEN is_discounted = TRUE THEN avg_days END) AS difference
FROM avg_by_discount
LIMIT 100
